desc: Implement helper `feasible(L)`: L == 1 → min mismatches to "0101..."/"1010..." patterns ≤ numOps; L ≥ 2 → sum `run_len // (L + 1)` over maximal runs ≤ numOps.

Verify per-run formula edge cases: run length L+1 needs 1 flip, length L needs 0, runs independent for L ≥ 2 (flips at interior offsets never merge across boundaries); L == 1 handled separately to avoid cross-run merging (e.g., "0011").
Implement binary search lo=1, hi=n; while lo < hi: mid=(lo+hi)//2; if feasible(mid): hi=mid else lo=mid+1; return lo.
Test three given examples plus: numOps=0 (answer = longest run), n=1, all-same with enough ops (answer 1), "0011" numOps=2 (answer 1), numOps ≥ n (answer 1).
Write final `Solution.minLength` in starter code, clean and commented, O(n log n) time, O(1) extra space.
